title: New Installation
shortDescription: Professional permanent LED lighting installation tailored to your home or business architecture. Track-mounted, colour-matched to your soffit.
fullDescription: Our new installation service transforms your property with professionally installed permanent LED track lighting. We begin with a free on-site consultation, take colour samples to match your soffit and fascia, then install a weatherproof, WiFi-connected system built for Ontario winters. Every installation includes mobile app setup and training so you can control every bulb from your phone.
features: Colour match to soffit and fascia

title: Repair Service
shortDescription: Fast, professional repair for any permanent outdoor lighting system. We diagnose and fix electrical, mounting, and app connectivity issues.
fullDescription: If your existing permanent lighting system has stopped working, our certified technicians will diagnose and repair it quickly. We work on all major brands and can replace individual LED modules, fix wiring, reseat tracks, and restore app connectivity. Most repairs are completed same-day.

title: Consultation
shortDescription: Not sure where to start? Our free in-home consultation covers design options, product selection, pricing, and answers all your questions.
fullDescription: Our free consultation visits are no-pressure and educational. A lighting specialist will walk your property, discuss design options, explain the technology, and provide a transparent, itemized quote. You'll leave with a clear plan and no obligation.

title: Maintenance
shortDescription: Annual inspection and cleaning packages to keep your permanent lighting system performing like new for decades.
fullDescription: Our optional annual maintenance package includes a full system inspection, cleaning, connection checks, app and controller firmware updates, and minor adjustments. Keep your investment in top condition and catch minor issues before they become costly repairs.

title: Replace Existing Lights
shortDescription: Upgrade your old permanent lighting system to our premium LED track system with better colour range, smarter controls, and a 25-year warranty.
fullDescription: Already have permanent outdoor lighting but want better performance, more colours, or modern app controls? We remove your old system cleanly and install our premium LED track lighting. Existing wiring is often reusable, which keeps costs down and installation time short.
features: New WiFi controller and mobile app
